title: Reconcile living documentation after a change
statement: As a developer, I can identify and repair documentation drift after implementing and reviewing a change so the Saga remains an accurate explanation of the current application.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The reconciliation report separates review diff coverage from living documentation currency at the selected head and distinguishes existing debt from regressions.
Code changes and requirement-only changes identify implicated records through declared links with reasons for reassessment.
The queue supplies typed inspection and repair paths, including complete-slide snapshots where required, and supports checking again without treating fresh pins as semantic proof.
